svg.title: Draw it: where the meaning was lost
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw the review and its tokens with a cross through every token that has no column in the vocabulary, add the surviving contributions into one total and squash that total into a probability, and write the smallest change that would fix it together with the four configuration scores of 0, 0, 6 and 7 out of 12.
svg.text: Draw it: where the meaning was lost
1. the review, its tokens, and a cross through every token with NO column
2. the surviving contributions added into one total, then squashed into p(positive)
3. the smallest change that would fix it, and the four scores: 0, 0, 6 and 7 of 12
